name: Sporthotel Alpenrose Wellness Residenz
beschreibung:
Overview

The Wellnessresidenz Alpenrose is a five-star hotel in Maurach am Achensee in Tyrol and is run by the Kostenzer family. The property lies on the edge of Maurach, just a few steps from Lake Achensee and near the Karwendel mountains. The heart of the offering is a spa and wellness area of around 8,500 square metres, spread over several levels and comprising various saunas, baths, infrared power spots and relaxation rooms. The bathing areas include a 23-metre sports pool with a ten-metre outdoor section, a brine pool under the open sky on the panoramic terrace, and an 800-square-metre swimming pond in the residence garden. In the kitchen, the hotel focuses on regional products and an extended half-board. The Alpenrose is one of the three founding members of Best Alpine Wellness Hotels.

History/Background

The house looks back on a long tradition. The hotel's own beauty farm bears the note “The Original. Since 1991.” According to its own account, the Alpenrose has been part of Best Alpine Wellness Hotels for around 35 years. The owner and host is Wolfgang Kostenzer, who describes the exchange among the member hotels as formative for the wellness offering. The lovingly tended garden was expanded to 12,000 square metres in 2019 and is considered the largest alpine-planted hotel garden in Austria. The house also contains artworks from the Austrian Renaissance as well as Tyrolean folk art.

Getting there

The address is Mühltalweg 10, 6212 Maurach/Achensee. By train, guests travel to Jenbach; the hotel collects its guests from the station free of charge. From Germany, the route leads via Munich, Rosenheim, Kufstein and Wörgl to Jenbach; from Switzerland, via Zurich, Buchs, Feldkirch and Innsbruck, likewise to Jenbach. Arriving by car, a luggage service and an underground car park are available. The nearest airports are Innsbruck (around 45 kilometres) and Munich (around 160 kilometres); the hotel arranges an airport transfer on request. The coordinates of the residence are given as 47°25'16.9"N 11°45'05.5"E.

Tips

The reception is staffed daily from 07:00 to 23:00. From Jenbach station, the Alpenrose offers a free transfer. The hotel provides e-bikes free of charge at reception. Children and young people between the ages of three and 15 are looked after daily from 09:30 to 22:00, complemented by a 220-square-metre play area and a fun park.

Best time to travel

Lake Achensee is a year-round destination. In the warm season, hiking, cycling and water sports take centre stage, while the cold months are for skiing, winter hiking and snowshoe hiking. For both seasons, the hotel points to a broad range of activities around Lake Achensee; a universally valid best time to travel cannot be derived from this.
